Contradictions to record from payload:
1. F1 says链路降级自主重排是首要缺口 (requires maintaining link-independence), while FI-1 challenges the assumption that value comes from continuous networking — direction conflict: 抗扰=维持链路 vs 默认静默不回传. Both coexist in payload; unresolved.
2. S4/S5 are intent/concept docs asserting integrated cross-domain fires as requirement vs S2/S3 audits saying integration/deployment lags — 意图与实测落差; evidence authority contextual.
3. F2 "常开有源即暴露" vs SC-03/SC-06 requiring continuous terminal detection & 独立回传评估 — 探测需求与辐射纪律矛盾.

5. Cost-exchange contradiction: core_contradiction says缺口主体是闭环节奏不是单平台峰值性能; while SC-04 pressure point emphasizes 低成本可续拦截 (platform/procurement economics). Also winning_metrics 成本交叉点 vs no quantified values (unresolved).
6. S2 and S3 flagged as needing cross-verification / not re-read vs used as supports for F2/F4/F5 — 证据治理冲突: 正式结论引用了未逐段核对的证据.

Analysis sections: build from scenarios SC-01..SC-06 and phases.

scenario_framework: background BG-1/2/3, phases S1渗透警戒→S2指示协同→S3压制降级→S4消耗再组织, triggers, task chain.

enemy_coa: most likely / most dangerous / alternative, with observable indicators.

critical_timeline: 关键时间窗 — but no numeric public values; use relative/conditional windows as assumptions, marked. e.g. 目标驻留分钟级以内 (from SC-06 constraints — that's in payload), 回传窗口按小时计 (SC-01), 备份节点12小时接管 (SC-02 failure condition), 72小时持续 (SC-04), 侦察断档>2小时 (SC-01). These are payload-stated constraints/hypotheses, fine as long as marked as framework assumptions not evidenced numbers.

environment_constraints: 电磁/频谱, 地理地形(岛链/山脊/城市峡谷), 气象海洋(高湿盐雾), 民用混用/GNSS遮蔽多径, 人力疲劳, 补给电力冷却, 规则与授权审查, 工业节拍. Map to capability pressure points.

scenario_branches: at least two — e.g. branch A 功率压制主导 (deep dependence on link hardening), branch B 欺骗/接管主导 (→ integrity gap, per F1 failure condition), branch C 自主末端寻的无回巡飞弹 (per F2 failure condition → shift to layered intercept), branch D 短冲突 vs 持续消耗 (F5 failure condition). Each with trigger, divergence node, consequence for gap prioritization.

capability_pressure_points: map to F1-F5 and task_effect.

assumptions: explicit list with basis, confidence, falsification.

Keep tight. ~1740 tokens budget. Let me write concisely but complete.

I'll also include open_questions maybe — but missing fields don't include open_questions; unresolved already exists. I can add "new_open_questions" but instruction says only fill missing_fields. I'll keep strictly to missing fields plus minimal metadata.
